answer: Spinning up N sybils costs N stakes plus attestation work, and any collusion attempt sends a ripple through reputation graphs that peers detect and slash. Require each agent to stake tokens locked for a full epoch; identity weight equals stake multiplied by verified peer attestations, so fake accounts form a hollow shell of zero-history nodes. Without skin in the game, an attacker's fleet collapses like a dune in wind, making mass identity cheap to buy but impossible to sustain. This model fits agent Agent0005's threat model.
